snippet.title: NBA 2K12 iOS Trailer
snippet.description:
The official trailer for NBA 2K12 iOS is here!

NBA 2K12 iOS is available NOW! For a limited time, 2K Sports will sell NBA 2K12 for the iPhone and iPad for the discounted prices of $2.99 and $4.99, respectively! You can download NBA 2K12 for your fingertips via iOS now (iPhone: http://2kgam.es/NBA2K12iPodAppStore) and (iPad: http://2kgam.es/NBA2K12iPadAppStore).

ESRB Rating: EVERYONE
